text:
Nocturno azul and plata… Over el clave
se esfuma el gold of la tarantela;
and el soul, in nuestra voice, se aterciopela
for hacer his caricia more suave.


El aire a besos and a ternura sabe,
and in el luar that in el garden riela,
las pupilas of the ángel that nos vela
of light enjoyan el silence grave.


La música se va… Tan sólo queda
un perfume fugaz a carne and seda…
¿Who tus encantos desnudó a la brisa?…


Ante your albor ni a respirar me atrevo,
and gota a gota, until embriagarme, bebo
todo el love of the mundo in your sonrisa!

translation.title: Tarantela
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
